svg.aria-label: Why latency explodes near full utilisation: at 50 percent busy a request rarely waits; at 80 percent it waits a few service times; at 95 percent queues are long and latency is many times the service time. Keep headroom.
svg.title: Why latency explodes near full utilisation: at 50 percent busy a request rarely waits; at 80 percent it waits a few service times; at 95 percent queues are long and latency is many times the service time. Keep headroom.
svg.text: Simple queue model: average wait ≈ ρ/(1−ρ) service times, where ρ = utilisation. Run CPUs at ~60–70% for latency-sensitive services.
